events.name: Baptism of Jesus

events.name: Battle of Jericho

events.name: Cain and Abel

events.kid_summary: Cain became angry when his offering was not accepted. God warned him, but Cain chose jealousy and hurt his brother.

events.name: Call of Abraham
events.summary: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God told Abram to leave his country and promised to bless him. Abram trusted God and went.

events.name: Conversion of Paul

events.kid_summary: Saul was going to hurt believers, but Jesus stopped him on the road. Saul became a servant of Jesus.

events.summary: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God created light, sky, land, plants, animals, and people. Everything God made showed His power and goodness.

events.name: Daniel Chooses Faithfulness
events.summary: Faithfulness starts with small choices to honor God. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Daniel and his friends were far from home, but Daniel resolved not to defile himself. God helped them.

events.name: Daniel in the Lions' Den
events.summary: Daniel kept praying to God even when a law said he could be punished. God protected Daniel in the lions' den and showed that He is faithful.
events.kid_summary: Daniel loved God and prayed every day. Some leaders made a trick law to get Daniel in trouble. Daniel kept praying to God, was thrown into a lions' den, and God shut the lions' mouths.

events.name: David and Goliath
events.summary: David faced Goliath when Israel's army was afraid. David trusted the Lord, remembered how God had helped him before, and defeated the giant.
events.kid_summary: Goliath was a huge soldier who scared Israel's army. David was young, but he knew God was stronger than any giant. David did not trust armor or size. He trusted the Lord and used a sling and a stone.

events.name: David and Jonathan
events.summary: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jonathan loved David as a friend and helped protect him. Their friendship showed loyalty and courage.

events.name: David Is Anointed
events.summary: God sees the heart, not just what people look like outside. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Samuel thought one of David's older brothers might be king, but God chose David. The Lord looks at the heart.

events.name: Deborah Leads with Courage
events.summary: God can give wisdom and courage to lead others toward what is right. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Deborah served as a judge in Israel. She helped Barak obey God's command and led with faith.

events.name: Elijah and the Ravens
events.summary: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God cared for Elijah during a drought. Ravens brought food, and later God provided through a widow's jar and jug.

events.name: Elijah on Mount Carmel
events.summary: The Lord alone is God, and worship belongs to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Elijah challenged the prophets of Baal. God answered by fire, showing the people that the Lord is God.

events.name: Esther Saves Her People
events.summary: Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Esther was afraid to go to the king, but she chose courage to help her people. Mordecai reminded her that her moment mattered.

events.name: Exodus
events.summary: God can make a way when His people cannot see one. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Israel was trapped between Pharaoh's army and the sea. God opened the sea, and His people crossed on dry ground.

events.name: Fall
events.summary: Sin breaks trust with God, but God still seeks and cares for people. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Adam and Eve lived in the garden and were given one command. They disobeyed God, and sin brought sadness and separation.

events.name: Flood
events.summary: Noah obeyed God by building the ark. God judged sin, saved Noah's family, and gave the rainbow as a sign of His promise.
events.kid_summary: People had filled the earth with wrong and hurtful things. God told Noah to build a big ark. Noah obeyed God, and God kept Noah, his family, and the animals safe through the flood.

events.name: Gideon Learns to Trust
events.summary: God sees what He can do through us even when we feel weak. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Gideon felt small and afraid. God called him a mighty man of valor and promised to be with him.

events.name: God Makes All Things New
events.summary: God promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: John saw a new heaven and new earth. God promised to make all things new and remove death, mourning, crying, and pain.

events.name: God Promises Abraham
events.summary: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Abram wondered how God's promise would happen. God showed him the stars and Abram believed the Lord.

events.name: Hannah Prays for a Son
events.summary: Prayer is bringing real sadness and hope to God. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Hannah was deeply sad and prayed to the Lord. God heard her, and she later had a son named Samuel.

events.name: Isaac Is Born
events.summary: God's timing can be surprising, but His promises do not fail. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God gave Abraham and Sarah a son named Isaac, just as He had promised. Their sadness turned into laughter.

events.name: Jacob and Esau
events.summary: Quick wants can lead to foolish choices when we forget what matters most. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Esau traded his birthright for stew because he wanted food right away. Jacob also acted selfishly.

events.name: Jacob Wrestles with God
events.summary: God can change people and give them a new way to walk. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jacob wrestled through the night and received a new name, Israel. He learned that blessing comes from God.

events.name: Jesus at the Temple
events.summary: Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: When Jesus was twelve, Mary and Joseph found Him in the temple. He was listening, asking questions, and speaking with wisdom.

events.name: Jesus Calls the First Disciples
events.summary: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus called fishermen to follow Him. They left their nets and became His disciples.

events.name: Jesus Calms the Storm
events.summary: Jesus has authority over creation and cares for fearful disciples. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: A storm frightened the disciples while Jesus was in the boat. Jesus spoke, and the wind and sea became calm.

events.name: Jesus Dies on the Cross
events.summary: Jesus gave His life to save sinners. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus was crucified between criminals. Even while suffering, He showed mercy and trusted the Father.

events.name: Jesus Feeds Five Thousand
events.summary: Jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: A boy had five loaves and two fish. Jesus gave thanks and fed a huge crowd with leftovers.

events.name: Jesus Is Born
events.summary: Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, and shepherds heard the good news from angels. They went to see Him and praised God.

events.name: Jesus Is Risen
events.summary: Jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Mary found the tomb empty and met the risen Jesus. The resurrection changed fear into good news.

events.name: Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
events.summary: Jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus prayed in the garden before the cross. He honestly brought His sorrow to the Father and submitted to His will.

events.name: Jesus Raises Lazarus
events.summary: Jesus has power over death and cares when people grieve. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus wept with Mary and Martha, then called Lazarus from the tomb. Many saw His power and believed.

events.name: Jesus Walks on Water
events.summary: Faith looks to Jesus when fear feels bigger than courage. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: The disciples saw Jesus walking on the water. Peter stepped out, became afraid, and Jesus rescued him.

events.name: Job Worships in Suffering
events.summary: God is worthy of trust and worship even when life hurts. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Job lost many things and grieved deeply. Even in pain, he did not accuse God of wrong.

events.name: Jonah Prays from the Fish
events.summary: We can pray to God from the deepest trouble. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jonah prayed from inside the fish. He remembered the Lord and thanked Him for rescue.

events.name: Jonah Runs from God
events.summary: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh, but Jonah ran the other way. God sent a storm and a great fish.

events.name: Joseph Forgives His Brothers
events.summary: Forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Joseph could have punished his brothers, but he forgave them. He saw that God had used hard things to save many lives.

events.name: Joseph's Dreams
events.summary: God can be at work even when family life is messy and painful. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Joseph had dreams that made his brothers angry. Their jealousy grew, but God was not finished with Joseph.

events.name: Joshua: Be Strong and Courageous
events.summary: God's presence gives courage for new responsibilities. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Joshua had to lead Israel after Moses. God told him to be strong and courageous because the Lord would be with him.

events.name: Josiah Finds God's Word
events.summary: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: King Josiah heard the Book of the Law and was sorry for Israel's sin. He wanted the people to listen to God.

events.name: Love Is Patient and Kind
events.summary: Love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Paul taught that impressive gifts are empty without love. Real love is patient, kind, humble, and lasting.

events.name: Made in God's Image
events.summary: Every person has value because God made people in His image. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God made people different from everything else He created. People can know God, reflect His care, and treat others with dignity.

events.name: Manna in the Wilderness
events.summary: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Israel was hungry in the wilderness. God gave manna each morning and taught them to gather what they needed.

events.name: Naaman Is Healed
events.summary: Humility means receiving God's help God's way. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Naaman wanted a grand cure, but Elisha told him to wash in the Jordan. When Naaman humbled himself, God healed him.

events.name: Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
events.summary: God's work often takes prayer, planning, courage, and teamwork. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Nehemiah saw Jerusalem's broken walls and called the people to rebuild. He trusted God's good hand.

events.name: Paul and Silas in Prison
events.summary: God can bring worship and witness even in hard places. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Paul and Silas prayed and sang in prison. God opened doors, and the jailer heard about Jesus.

events.name: Peter and Cornelius
events.summary: The good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God sent Peter to Cornelius, a Gentile. Peter learned that God welcomes people from every nation who turn to Him.

events.name: Peter and John Help a Lame Man
events.summary: Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Peter and John saw a man who could not walk. In Jesus' name, he was healed and began praising God.

events.name: Philip and the Ethiopian Official
events.summary: God can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Philip met a man reading Isaiah and explained the good news about Jesus. The man believed and was baptized.

events.name: Ruth Stays with Naomi
events.summary: Faithful love stays near and serves when life is hard. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Ruth chose to stay with Naomi and follow Naomi's God. Her loyal love became part of God's bigger story.

events.name: Samuel Hears God
events.summary: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Samuel heard his name at night and learned that the Lord was speaking. He answered with a listening heart.

events.name: Sermon on the Mount
events.summary: Jesus teaches that God's kingdom values humility, mercy, purity, and peace. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus described the blessed life in God's kingdom. His words showed a different kind of greatness.

events.name: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
events.summary: Wisdom is better than showing off because it helps us honor God and serve people. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God asked Solomon what he wanted. Solomon asked for wisdom to lead God's people well.

events.name: Solomon Builds the Temple
events.summary: Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem as a place for Israel to worship the Lord.
events.kid_summary: Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem as a place for Israel to worship the Lord.

events.name: Temptation of Jesus
events.summary: Jesus answered temptation with God's Word and remained faithful. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, but He did not sin. He answered each temptation with Scripture.

events.name: The Armor of God
events.summary: God gives His people truth, faith, salvation, Scripture, and prayer for spiritual strength. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Paul pictured God's help like armor. Believers stand strong by depending on the Lord.

events.name: The Burning Bush
events.summary: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Moses saw a bush burning without burning up. God told him He had heard Israel's cries and would send Moses.

events.name: The Fiery Furnace
events.summary: God is able to rescue, and His people can stay faithful even before they know the outcome. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refused to worship the statue. God was with them in the fire.

events.name: The Fruit of the Spirit
events.summary: The Holy Spirit grows Christlike character in God's people. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Paul described love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control as the Spirit's fruit.

events.name: The Golden Calf
events.summary: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: While Moses was on the mountain, the people made a golden calf. They forgot the God who had rescued them.

events.name: The Good Samaritan
events.summary: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus told about a Samaritan who helped a hurt man when others passed by. Mercy means stopping to help.

events.name: The Great Commission
events.summary: Jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: After rising from the dead, Jesus sent His disciples to teach and baptize all nations. He promised His presence.

events.name: The Holy Spirit Comes at Pentecost
events.summary: God gives the Holy Spirit and gathers people from many nations. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: The Holy Spirit came upon the believers at Pentecost. People from many places heard the mighty works of God.

events.name: The Last Supper
events.summary: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus shared bread and cup with His disciples and told them to remember Him.

events.name: The Lord Is My Shepherd
events.summary: God cares for His people like a shepherd cares for sheep. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Psalm 23 pictures the Lord as a shepherd who provides, guides, protects, and stays near His people.

events.name: The Lord's Prayer
events.summary: Jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus taught His followers how to pray. The prayer begins with honoring the Father and asks for daily needs and forgiveness.

events.name: The Parable of the Sower
events.summary: God's Word should be received with a heart that listens and grows. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus told about seed falling on different soils. The good soil pictures a heart that receives God's Word.

events.name: The Passover
events.summary: God makes a way of rescue and teaches His people to remember. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God gave Israel the Passover so they would remember His rescue. The lamb and meal pointed to God's saving power.

events.name: The Prodigal Son
events.summary: God welcomes repentant sinners with mercy and joy. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: A son wasted what he had and came home ashamed. His father ran to welcome him back.

events.name: The Ten Commandments
events.summary: God's commands show His holiness and teach His people how to love Him and others. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: God gave commandments to Israel after rescuing them. His law showed how His people should live with Him and one another.

events.name: The Tower of Babel
events.summary: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: The people tried to build a tower to make a name for themselves. God confused their language and scattered them.

events.name: Wise and Foolish Builders
events.summary: Wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Jesus compared obedient listeners to a wise builder on rock. Hearing without obeying is like building on sand.

events.name: Zacchaeus Meets Jesus
events.summary: Jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.
events.kid_summary: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus came to his house, and Zacchaeus chose to make wrong things right.

objects.summary: David used simple stones while trusting God against Goliath.

quiz_banks.summary: Reusable quiz questions from the Beginnings and Promises lesson pack.

questions.question: Who made the heavens and the earth?
This lesson teaches that god made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
Why should we treat people with respect?
questions.answer: People are made in God's image

questions.question: This lesson teaches that every person has value because God made people in His image.
What happened when Adam and Eve disobeyed God?
This lesson teaches that sin breaks trust with God, but God still seeks and cares for people.
What did God warn Cain about?
questions.answer: Sin was crouching at the door

questions.question: This lesson teaches that anger must be brought to God before it grows into sin.
What did God tell Noah to build?
The rainbow reminded Noah that God keeps His ____.
Why did the people build the tower?
questions.answer: To make a name for themselves

questions.question: This lesson teaches that pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.
What did Abram do when God called him?
questions.answer: He went as God told him

questions.question: This lesson teaches that faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
Who chose land first?
This lesson teaches that peace sometimes means letting go instead of grabbing first place.
What did God show Abram?
This lesson teaches that god keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
What was Abraham and Sarah's son named?
This lesson teaches that god's timing can be surprising, but His promises do not fail.
What did God provide instead?
This lesson teaches that god provides and calls His people to trust Him deeply.
What did Esau trade away?
This lesson teaches that quick wants can lead to foolish choices when we forget what matters most.
What new name was Jacob given?
This lesson teaches that god can change people and give them a new way to walk.
Who became angry about Joseph's dreams?
This lesson teaches that god can be at work even when family life is messy and painful.
What did Joseph choose instead of revenge?
This lesson teaches that forgiveness trusts God with the hurt and chooses mercy instead of revenge.

This lesson teaches that jesus sends His followers to make disciples and promises to be with them.

This lesson teaches that god gives the Holy Spirit and gathers people from many nations.
In whose name was the man healed?
This lesson teaches that jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need.

This lesson teaches that god can guide His people to help others understand Scripture and Jesus.
Who met Saul on the road?
This lesson teaches that jesus can change even the hardest heart and give a new mission.
Who did Peter visit?
This lesson teaches that the good news of Jesus is for every nation and people group.
What did Paul and Silas do in prison?
This lesson teaches that god can bring worship and witness even in hard places.
Who grows this fruit in God's people?
This lesson teaches that the Holy Spirit grows Christlike character in God's people.
What sword is named in the armor of God?
This lesson teaches that god gives His people truth, faith, salvation, Scripture, and prayer for spiritual strength.
What does Paul say love is?
This lesson teaches that love matters because God calls His people to patient, humble, faithful care.
What does God promise to make new?
This lesson teaches that god promises a future where He dwells with His people and wipes away every tear.

God protected Daniel in the lions' den.
What did Nehemiah help rebuild?
This lesson teaches that god's work often takes prayer, planning, courage, and teamwork.
